title: Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing Campaigns
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Opportunity

Nebius is looking for an experienced integrated campaign marketer to turn audience insight into campaigns that grow brand awareness, reach the right customers, and generate qualified demand. You will own the strategy and execution of city-specific campaigns, campaigns around our biggest events, and evergreen campaigns connecting a defined persona with a relevant solution.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role. You will research audiences, build campaign plans, write briefs, guide execution, and measure results. You will lead cross-functional teams and agencies without direct line authority, with the opportunity to grow into a team lead as the function evolves.

What you will own

  • Own local and evergreen city-specific campaigns. Research priority markets, target personas, buying behaviours, local communities, trusted influencers, and trade publications. Translate those insights into integrated plans that combine the digital and physical channels most relevant to each audience.
  • Build campaigns around major events. Own the integrated campaign plan before, during, and after tier 1 and selected tier 2 events. Partner with Events to extend Nebius awareness and customer reach through digital media, physical activations, influencers, third-party publications, content syndication, and coordinated follow-up.
  • Develop evergreen and solution campaigns. Build sustained programs around a specific persona, business need, and Nebius solution. Create launch activations and ongoing campaigns for priorities such as new hardware, industry use cases, inference, and agentic AI, tailoring messages, offers, and channels to the intended outcome.
  • Turn strategy into execution. Define campaign objectives, customer journeys, channel roles, asset requirements, budgets, timelines, and responsibilities. Write clear briefs, manage dependencies, and work directly with channel owners and agencies to launch coherent campaigns and resolve execution gaps.
  • Lead across teams. Align Product Marketing, Brand / Creative, Content, Digital, Events, Partner Marketing, Sales, and Marketing Operations around one campaign plan. Secure commitments, clarify decisions, and connect campaign engagement to relevant sales or nurture follow-up.
  • Activate partners. Identify where partners add audience access, credibility, or distribution. Develop co-branded content and joint activations with clear shared objectives, responsibilities, follow-up plans, and measures of success.
  • Own agency and vendor performance. Select and brief partners, define scope, deliverables, budgets, and quality standards, and hold them accountable for execution and results. Provide actionable feedback and manage spend and trade-offs throughout the campaign.
  • Define measurement and attribution. Agree baselines, KPIs, tracking, and reporting with Marketing Operations and analytics before launch. Assess awareness, target-audience engagement, qualified demand, pipeline contribution, and efficiency against campaign goals. Use controlled tests or geographic comparisons where feasible and distinguish attributed results from incremental impact.
  • Build repeatable, AI-powered campaign systems. Turn persona research, channel selection, briefs, journey maps, and measurement plans into reusable frameworks that use AI to generate a first version of the customer journey, creative, and cross-channel activations within days, then refine with feedback to launch within weeks. Build in feedback loops that use campaign signals and results to automate improvements to audience targeting, creative, channel mix, and budget allocation—enabling one person to scale across different campaign types.
  • Use AI to accelerate the work. Apply AI to persona and market research, campaign planning, and rapid prototyping of assets and customer journeys. Validate findings and creative quality, document effective workflows, and use the time saved to test and improve campaigns.

What success looks like

  • Within 90 days, establish a prioritized campaign roadmap, an agreed measurement framework, and initial audience and market insights, with the first priority campaign launched.
  • Deliver coordinated local, event, and evergreen campaigns with clear audience choices, channel rationale, ownership, and follow-up.
  • Demonstrate improvements in awareness, relevant customer reach, qualified engagement, and pipeline contribution against agreed campaign baselines and goals.
  • Keep teams, agencies, and partners aligned on commitments, delivering campaigns on time and within agreed budgets.
  • Build a repeatable campaign framework that reduces planning and launch time and turns measured results into better campaign decisions.

What you bring

  • 8+ years of experience in integrated campaigns, demand generation, or Account-based marketing, including significant hands-on ownership of multi-channel programs at scale.
  • Minimum of 4-5 years leading integrated campaigns for 1 or 2 companies.
  • A proven record of delivering integrated campaigns with measurable business outcomes. You can explain your personal contribution, what worked, what did not, and how those lessons changed your approach.
  • Strong audience and market research skills. You can identify decision-makers, understand their needs and trusted sources, and explain why particular messages, channels, and offers will reach them.
  • Experience combining digital and physical channels into a connected customer journey, with sound judgment about local relevance, event amplification, and sustained demand creation.
  • Creative thinking about media and activation. You see opportunities beyond traditional formats, turning local partnerships, street marketing, and unexpected touchpoints into relevant ways to reach your audience. You challenge agencies and partners to think beyond standard media plans and uncover distinctive opportunities that others overlook.
  • A clear point of view on measurement and attribution. You can define success for different campaign types, interpret incomplete data, and distinguish engagement metrics, pipeline influence, and evidence of incremental impact.
  • Proven agency and vendor management skills, including selection, briefing, scope and budget management, creative feedback, and performance accountability.
  • Strong systems thinking and practical use of AI. You turn campaign experience into reusable research methods, planning templates, workflows, and learning loops.
  • The ability to lead through influence. You bring cross-functional teams along, resolve competing priorities, communicate decisions clearly, and remain accountable for outcomes without managing every contributor.
  • Comfort operating as a senior individual contributor: you can set strategy and do the work yourself, manage multiple campaigns, and make thoughtful trade-offs with limited resources.

Experience that would be especially valuable

  • Experience in B2B technology, cloud infrastructure, AI, developer platforms, or enterprise software, reaching technical and business audiences.
  • Experience building city-specific or regional campaigns informed by local audience research and media habits.
  • Experience extending the impact of major industry events through coordinated campaigns before, during, and after the event.
  • A track record of co-marketing with technology or ecosystem partners, including joint content, distribution, and activation.
  • Experience using CRM, marketing automation, account-based marketing, and campaign analytics tools to connect activity with account engagement and commercial outcomes.

The profile we are looking for

You think like a strategist and work like a builder. You start with the audience and the business outcome, choose channels with purpose, and bring people together around a clear plan. You are comfortable moving from research to a creative brief, from an agency review to a campaign dashboard, and from results to the next experiment. You are ready to own the work as a senior individual contributor and help build a scalable integrated campaign capability at Nebius.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Autonomous Systems Security Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote-Friendly (Travel Required) | San Francisco, CA

 About Anthropic

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role

 Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. You'll be the engineer who owns autonomous systems across that footprint as one security domain, from both sides: drones, ground robots and automated vehicles for patrol, inspection and moving hardware, including the security of that automation inside secure areas, and the detection systems that tell us what is flying over or operating near a site uninvited.

 You set the approach, select and integrate the platforms and sensors, write the requirements vendors build to, and run what you ship, from the operating model where operators assign missions and machines carry them out to the playbook that turns a detection into an identified track and a well-evidenced handoff to whoever holds authority over the airspace. Interdiction is not part of this role. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, fleet health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

 You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations and legal teams, and directly with site operators, equipment vendors and aviation and public safety authorities. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

 Key responsibilities

•
 Autonomous security and inspection systems: own the drones, ground robots and other autonomous platforms for perimeter patrol, incident response and infrastructure inspection: platform selection, operating model, operator qualification, maintenance, and the data path from machine to analyst

•
 Tools, automation and AI agents: build the integrations that carry detections, tracks, telemetry and fleet health into the team's security monitoring platform, and the tools and agents that triage detections, check fleet health and assemble evidence. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it

•
 Detection of uncrewed systems: engineer the sensing that tells us what is flying over or operating near a site, what it is and who needs to know: sensor selection and evaluation against live targets, per-site coverage, classification and false-alarm handling, and the playbook from first detection to handoff, with evidence retained

•
 Security of site automation: engineer the controls on automated vehicles, robots and similar machines that move hardware or work inside secure areas: identity and access, network isolation, what they may record and where it goes, fail-secure behavior, their place in chain of custody, and acceptance before they enter a site

•
 Regulatory and site constraints: establish what we may sense, fly, drive, record and retain at each site, partner-operated sites included, under the aviation, spectrum, privacy and safety rules that apply there, with the waivers and approvals that extend it and coordination with local authorities set up before it is needed

•
 Health monitoring: define and test heartbeats, loss-of-coverage and lost-link alarms and fail-secure behavior, so a silent sensor or machine shows as a fault, not a quiet day

•
 Vendor requirements and acceptance: write the requirements, evaluate against live flights and runs, and hold vendors to what they ship

 Minimum qualifications

•
 Have engineered autonomous or sensing systems in the field (drones, ground robots, automated vehicles, or RF, radar or optical detection sensors): selected, integrated or secured them for an operation other people relied on, and verified what they actually do against real targets or runs rather than a datasheet

•
 Have integrated systems you did not build (vendor APIs, SDKs, appliances, machine and sensor telemetry) into a platform that outlives any one of them

•
 Read and review code, design the data systems behind security tooling, and build automation (often with AI coding agents) using Git and code review

•
 Have done this work hands-on for data centers, critical infrastructure or a large hardware fleet

•
 Have designed inside a regulatory or safety constraint (aviation, spectrum, privacy, machine safety or similar) and can show the decision it drove

•
 Own a domain end to end: set the approach, carry it through with vendors, site operators, partners and authorities, and run it as something people depend on every day

 Preferred qualifications

•
 Remote pilot certification (for example FAA Part 107) and experience flying beyond visual line of sight under a waiver or exemption

•
 Experience with counter-drone (counter-UAS) detection, airspace surveillance or air traffic data systems

•
 Experience running a robot, drone or automated-vehicle fleet in an industrial, logistics or data center setting: fleet management, mission planning, safety cases

•
 Experience securing embedded, operational technology or robotic systems: device identity, network segmentation, update control, logging

•
 Experience with physical security operations at large sites, with law enforcement or aviation authorities, or at sites you did not fully control: cloud, colocation or GPU cloud operators

•
 Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual work

 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

 Annual Salary:
 $320,000 — $405,000 USD

 Logistics

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different

 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us!

 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/anthropic-autonomous-systems-security-engineer

title: Backend Engineer (Python),AI Engineering: Agent Foundations
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer.

Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You'll also work across the stack where needed. You'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

What you'll do

  • Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.
  • Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry.
  • Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.
  • Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI.
  • Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.
  • Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.
  • Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.
  • Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models.
  • Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses.
  • Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.
  • Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and/or JavaScript and Vue is a plus.
  • Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.
  • Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.

About the team

The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution. Between them, they own the GitLab Duo Developer foundational flow and the Flow Registry; the AI Catalog, including custom agents, custom flows and external agent integrations; and agent execution, agent tools and agent observability.

Our engineers work async-first across EMEA, AMER, and India timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

title: Design Technology Technician
description:
Job Title: Technician (Design Technology)  

Actual Annual Salary: £22,947 - £25,010 (Based on hours and weeks worked)  

Full Time Equivalent Salary: £26,798 - £29,208 (CLF Grade B) Based on full time hours, all year round.  

Contract Type: Permanent  

Hours: 37 hours per week - Full Time, Term Time Only plus Inset days  

Potential Start Date: January 2027 (Subject to completion of pre-employment checks)  

An opportunity to use your practical and technical expertise to support outstanding teaching and learning in Design & Technology.  

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Design & Technology Technician to join Broadoak Academy on a permanent basis. This role offers the chance to support the delivery of an engaging Design & Technology curriculum by providing technical assistance, preparing specialist resources, and helping to maintain a safe, well-organised learning environment for students and staff.  

Working closely with the Curriculum Lead, teachers and wider academy colleagues, you will prepare, organise and maintain the equipment, materials and resources required for practical activities across the department. This may include supporting areas such as resistant materials, graphics, as well as managing stock, setting up and clearing away resources, and ensuring specialist equipment is available and ready for use.  

A key aspect of the role is promoting high standards of health and safety. You will support compliance with relevant regulations, undertake routine equipment checks, contribute to risk assessments, and help staff and students use specialist tools and machinery safely and effectively.  

You will build positive working relationships with students, staff, suppliers and contractors, providing practical advice and technical support where needed. The role also offers opportunities to contribute to wider academy activities, including open evenings, enrichment events and departmental projects.  

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised, proactive and practically minded individual who enjoys working in a busy educational environment. Whether you have previous technician experience or transferable skills from industry, you will play an important role in supporting students' learning while developing your own technical expertise as part of a dedicated and supportive team at Broadoak Academy.  

About you  

You will:  

  • Be committed to maintaining high standards of health, safety and organisation within a practical learning environment.  
  • Have a proactive and flexible approach, with the ability to manage a varied workload and adapt to changing priorities.  
  • Be passionate about supporting young people and contributing to a positive educational experience for all students.  
  • Demonstrate excellent teamwork, professionalism and communication skills when working with staff, students and external stakeholders.  
  • Value continuous professional development and be committed to developing your technical knowledge and skills.  

You will have:  

  • Good literacy and numeracy skills, including GCSE English and Maths at Grade 4/C or above (or equivalent).  
  • Experience of working with specialist equipment and following established procedures and safe working practices.  
  • The ability to maintain, clean, organise and support the safe use of tools, machinery and resources.  
  • Strong organisational, administration and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.  
  • Confident IT skills and the ability to maintain accurate records and inventories.  
  • An understanding of health and safety requirements, including COSHH and safe workshop practices, or a willingness to develop this knowledge.  
  • A clear commitment to safeguarding, equality, inclusion and the wellbeing of children and young people.  

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached Job Description and Person Specification before submitting an application.  

About Broadoak Academy:  

Broadoak Academy is an ever-growing secondary school located in Weston-super-Mare and is quickly becoming the school of choice for parents in the town. We are very proud to be an Ofsted-rated ‘Good’ school. We have a strong sense of belonging and community, and as such, we work together to offer students a well-balanced, happy and successful education. Our community is assured of Broadoak’s pivotal role in their children’s education, wellbeing and futures. 

Why work at CLF?    

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others.    

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion.   

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered  

What we can offer you:  

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS).  
  • Generous annual leave.  
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities.  
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme.  
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs.  
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay.  
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more!  

Recruitment timeline:    

  • Closing Date: 30 November 2026 @11.59pm  
  • Shortlisting date: 01 December 2026  
  • Interviews: 08 December 2026 

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment.    

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.     

Please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.    

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out.      

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

title: Level 1 Teaching Assistant 1-1
description:
Job Title: 1-1 Teaching Assistant Level 1 – Grade B – KS1 

Actual Annual Salary:  £20,156 - £21,968 Based on hours and week worked 

Full-Time Equivalent Salary: £26,798 - £29,208 (CLF Grade B) Based on full-time hours, all year round. 

Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract 

Contract Length: Fixed until 31 August 2027 

Hours: 32.5 hours per week - Part Time, Term Time Only + Inset days  

Additional information:  Monday to Friday, 6.5 hours per day 

Potential Start Date: January 2027 (Subject to completion of pre-employment checks) 

An opportunity to empower students to reach their full potential by delivering tailored support that enhances learning, engagement, and well-being. 

We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic Teaching Assistant Level 1 to join the team at Wallscourt Farm Academy. This role is a 1-1 Teaching Assistant link to funding for specific children in Key stage 1. 

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable working independently and as part of a strong, collaborative team that champions inclusion and believes every child can succeed. You will support a learner within the classroom, on a one-to-one basis, adapting your approach to meet individual learning needs and ensuring all pupils can access the curriculum and achieve their full potential. 

Working closely with teachers and other colleagues, you will support the educational, social, and emotional development of pupils through the delivery of planned learning activities and targeted interventions. You will take an active role in leading interventions, supporting learners with SEND needs, and helping to create positive learning experiences that promote engagement, confidence, wellbeing, and measurable improvements in pupil outcomes. 

This role is ideal for someone who is committed to making a meaningful difference in the lives of young people and who has a genuine passion for inclusion, personalised support, and helping every child succeed. 

About You 

We are looking for someone who: 

  • Is committed to inclusion and ensuring every child feels valued, supported and able to succeed. 
  • Can work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team. 
  • Has a genuine passion for improving the life chances of children and helping them reach their full potential. 
  • Understands the role of a Teaching Assistant and how to support pupils' learning, development and wellbeing within the classroom. 
  • Can build positive relationships with pupils, colleagues, parents and carers. 
  • Can engage and motivate children on a one-to-one basis and within small groups, using positive behaviour management strategies. 
  • Demonstrates patience, empathy, resilience and emotional intelligence when supporting children with a wide range of needs.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

  • Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

  • Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

  • Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

  • Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

  • Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

  • Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

  • Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

  • A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

  • Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

  • Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

  • Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

  • Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

  • AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

  • Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

  • The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.

  • You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

  • You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.

  • You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

  • You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

  • Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

  • Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

  • Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis.

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options.

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. Ensure your CV reflects clearly of the actual experience you have across those areas.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications

description:
Headquarters: Canada

 URL: http://www.mozilla.org

 Why Mozilla?
 Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

 The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

 About this team and role:
 Mozilla Finance partners with business units to drive strategic resource allocation and financial insight across our product portfolio. Our team of analysts supports revenue and cost ownership across Search, Advertising, Firefox, Marketing, and New Products.

 We're adding a commercially-minded analyst will cover three areas: New Products (revenue and costs for B2B and SaaS-type initiatives), Ads revenue analysis in partnership with our Data Science team, and Marketing cost including labor and program spend reconciliation through close.

 Beyond ownership of those areas, you'll contribute to the team's broader push to standardize how we plan and report. This role reports to the Senior Director, Finance and works alongside three senior analysts.

 The right person has done commercial finance in a B2B environment, is comfortable working with data scientists, and doesn't wait to be asked before making something better.

 What you'll do:

• Own New Products financials : Maintain the forecast for New Products revenue and costs (labor + program spend). Validate inputs, reconcile actuals through close, and document drivers. Maintain position-level detail on how labor is forecasted and reported

• B2B Financial Modelling. Once a B2B deal or New Products initiative is live, maintain an ongoing financial model, updating commercial assumptions as the business evolves. Keep operating view current as actuals come in and support with ad hoc scenarios as needed.

• Support Ads revenue analysis. Partner with Data Science to conduct deep-dive research into Ads revenue trends, building the analytical frameworks and recurring views that help the business understand performance and pursue growth. Translate findings into clear insights .

• Marketing cost reconciliation. Support reconciliation of Marketing program spend, coordinating with the Marketing cost lead to ensure accuracy through close and flagging issues before they compound.

• Drive team standardization and reporting : Help build shared processes and templates so results can be presented as a unified view.

• Be a reliable business partner. Field data and reporting questions, anticipate stakeholder needs, and communicate complex information in terms non-finance partners can use — escalating items that call for a broader partnership discussion.

• Apply AI and automation to recurring work: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across forecast, close, and reporting cycles.

 What you'll bring:
 Core Experience

• 3–5 years of experience in commercial finance, B2B finance, FP&A, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis.

• B2B commercial experience required. Familiarity with revenue modeling, deal economics, or partner, SaaS, or subscription revenue models in a B2B context.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

 Technical Skills

• Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy.

• Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred).

• Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle.

• Comfort working with data science or analytics teams. Able to interpret analytical outputs, ask the right questions, and translate findings into financial terms.

• Experience with revenue analysis or commercial modeling, including reconciling actuals to forecast in a multi-product or multi-channel environment.

• Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work.

• Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy.

 Communication & Collaboration

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance, a revenue trend, or a forecast assumption clearly to a non-finance audience.

• Experience building effective working relationships across functions. You know when to loop people in, can adjust how you present depending on who's in the room, and back your points with both numbers and context.

• Ability to distill complex detail into structured summaries that business partners and senior stakeholders can act on.

• Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and the drive to learn a new business quickly.

 Nice to have:

• Experience in B2B SaaS revenue analysis, digital advertising, and search monetization

• Familiarity with revenue reconciliation or commercial reporting in a multi-product environment

• Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context, or the drive and resourcefulness to learn.

• Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages.

 Success Factors
 You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you…

• Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines.

• Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adjust to differing viewpoints.

• Are resourceful. You identify alternative solutions and resources to continue progress.

• Learn new businesses fast. You ask the right questions, connect dots quickly, and build credibility with stakeholders through understanding what drives their results — not just the numbers.

• See process gaps as opportunities. You spot inefficiencies and fix them without being asked. By the end of your first year, New Products is running on a clean forecast model, the team has at least one shared reporting process it didn't have before, and you've made the Ads revenue picture meaningfully clearer.

 What you'll get:

• Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team

• Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

• Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together

• Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday

• One-time home office stipend

• Annual professional development budget

 About Mozilla

 Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

 Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

 Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation s, gender identities, and expressions.

title: Teacher of Science
description:
Why apply to be a Teacher of Science at Riverside School?

Riverside School opened in September 2012, we have now moved into our new state-of the-art £45m building on the north bank of the Thames with over 1200 students from Year 7 to 13; we will grow to approximately 2000 over the next 3 years, including a large sixth form. This is a great career opportunity to be part of a new and expanding school. It really is a very special place to work.

Our relentless focus on teaching and learning and developing great teachers and leaders is our number one priority. Weekly one-to-one tailored coaching sessions, termly lesson study and a generous time allocation to planning means our teachers are both motivated and highly talented. There is a real sense of passion and determination that students and staff bring to all that they do, making Riverside School a superb place both to learn and to work.

Riverside School achieved a P8 score of +0.92 (validated results) and is in the top 4% nationally for P8 for the following groups overall: all students, low prior attainers, middle prior attainers, high prior attainers and disadvantaged. 61% (20% nationally) of our students achieved the strong Ebacc and an attainment 8 score of 55.5 (46 nationally). We pride ourselves on consistency and academic rigour to enable social mobility.

The Science department is comprised 12 dynamic, engaging and enthusiastic teachers. We have a well-resourced department, allowing the students to learn science through enquiry and discovery.

We are looking to appoint an innovative and conscientious Teacher of Science with excellent subject knowledge and the ability to teach KS3 to KS5 science in our highly successful and collaborative department.

The successful candidate will:

  • Have a passion for science evident in their day to day teaching.
  • Show evidence of being, or having the potential to be, an outstanding teacher in the classroom.
  • Contribute and show commitment to our innovative and forward thinking department.
  • Contribute to intervention programmes.
  • Play a full and active role in the life of the school.
  • Be a reflective practitioner with focusses on continuous learning and development of practice.
  • Want to make a real difference to the lives of all young people.

In return, we can offer you:

  • A cohesive team of people who believe in working collaboratively; sharing ideas and supporting each other.
  • The opportunity to further develop innovative teaching and learning strategies to ensure students achieve excellence.
  • Participation in lesson study to provide an opportunity for collaborative planning and the detailed and evaluative analysis of specific pedagogical foci.
  • The chance to join a growing school with further opportunities for progression as the school reaches capacity.
  • Unrivalled CPDL opportunities to further develop your skills as a classroom practitioner and to develop leadership skills as you progress.
  • Purpose built and well-furnished 90m² labs with suites of computers in our brand new £45 million school.

If you share in our commitment to achieve excellence for all, we want to hear from you.

To find out more about our school please visit https://secondary.riversidecampus.com/

Please contact Headteacher: Andrew Roberts, on 020 3946 5888 or email riverside@riverside.bardaglea.org.uk

Early applications are encouraged as we may interview and offer to a candidate before the closing date.

Visa Sponsorship is available for the successful candidate. Please contact us directly.

The school is committed to safeguarding and protecting the welfare of children and as such all appointments are subject to an enhanced DBS check and digital screening. Appointments are also subject to satisfactory references/medical clearance.

title: Sous Chef
description:
The Avenue School is a growing school, expanding to reach full capacity of 104 places serving the needs of pupils with autism and complex needs.

Our Trust mission: ‘love, learn, laugh’, underpins our key aim to improve our pupils’ lives and outcomes through outstanding educational practice and provision, while also setting challenging and aspirational goals designed to empower our pupils and enhance their life choices. We strongly believe that school is the opportunity for children to discover and unlock hidden talents in a fun and nurturing environment, as we believe every child has the ability to do amazing things if a school provides the right opportunities.

We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic Sous Chef to support the delivery of nutritious, high-quality meals within our SEND school. Working closely with the Head Chef, you will help plan, prepare and serve food that meets a range of dietary, medical and sensory needs, ensuring every student has a safe and positive mealtime experience. The ideal candidate will contribute to the success of the school by delivering a first-class service in providing hot meals to students and staff that is nutritionally balanced and meets all religious and dietary requirements. It is essential that the post holder is able to work as part of a team and get along with a wide range of stakeholders.

description:

Bure Park Specialist Academy

16a Keyes Avenue

Great Yarmouth

NR30 4AE


Vacancy:

Administrator with timetabling responsibilities

Scale D5 - 6 (£26,428 - £26,847 pro rata)

Actual Salary £19,878 - £20,193 per annum

32.5 hours per week - Monday to Friday 7:30am - 2:30pm

Term Time plus 1 week

Make a Real Difference at Bure Park Specialist Academy

Come and join our growing team at Bure Park Specialist Academy and be part of the successful Broad Horizons Education Trust.

We are looking to appoint an enthusiastic, motivated, and dedicated Administrator with Timetabling Responsibilities to join us at our school in Great Yarmouth. Bure Park is a residential special school for boys aged 6-16 with social, emotional, and mental health (SEMH) difficulties. We are proud of our Ofsted 'Good' rating, with our residential provision rated 'Outstanding'.

Our school shares the vision of our Trust: improving the life chances of all pupils has to be at the heart of all we do. To achieve this, we firmly believe in valuing and championing every member of staff. This is an exciting opportunity to join an exceptional team who strive to establish the highest standards and play a fundamental role in changing children’s lives.

The Role

The school office is a busy, fast-paced environment, and this post is vital to the smooth daily running of the school. Operating from 7:30am each morning, you will be the engine room of our daily operations—managing timetables, coordinating daily cover, and ensuring staffing allocations seamlessly support our pupils.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Timetable Management: Populate, maintain, and update master, break, lunch, and specialist pathway (Bridge and Satellite) timetables using master versions created by senior leaders.

  • Daily Cover & Absence: Receive daily absence details, coordinate internal and external supply agency cover, and add daily absences to whole-school briefing slides.

  • Operational Coordination: Work closely with SLT, teaching and residential staff, on-call teams, and office management (including matching timetables with transport requirements).

  • Safeguarding & Pupil Welfare: Ensure cover arrangements cater to the specific supervision and SEMH needs of our pupils, escalating any staffing shortages that could compromise safety.

  • Clear Communication: Inform affected staff promptly of schedule changes throughout the day while maintaining accurate records and document version control.

About You

Personal qualities are of paramount importance. We are looking for an individual who displays enthusiasm, energy, good humour, flexibility, and reliability, alongside the ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing sight of the finer details.

Essential Requirements:

  • Proven experience in an administrative, clerical, or coordination role.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise effectively in a fast-paced setting.

  • Good general ICT skills (word processing, spreadsheets, data-based applications, and electronic record-keeping).

  • Solution-focused approach, remaining calm and adaptable under morning pressure.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills across all levels of staff.

  • High standards of discretion, confidentiality, and a deep commitment to safeguarding.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience within an educational setting, particularly an SEMH or residential provision.

  • Prior experience coordinating school timetables, daily cover, or using school MIS software.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Senior Operations Manager  

Actual Annual Salary: £44,818 - £48,280 (CLF Grade G) based on full-time hours, all year round 

Contract Type: Permanent 

Hours: Full-Time, 37 hours per week, All Year Round 

Provisional Start Date: January 2027 – pending completion of pre-employment checks 

Are you an experienced operational leader looking to make a real difference in education? Winterstoke Hundred Academy is seeking a highly organised, proactive and strategic Senior Operations Manager to play a pivotal role in the effective leadership and day-to-day running of the Academy. This role will work closely with the Principal, leading on the non-educational functions that enable staff and students to thrive. 

As a key member of the Academy's leadership team, you will lead the Professional Services function, providing strategic oversight of administration, compliance, health and safety, HR support and recruitment activities. You will be responsible for ensuring robust systems, processes and procedures are in place, supporting the smooth operation of the Academy and maintaining the highest standards of compliance and safeguarding.  

About you:  

You will:

  • Lead and manage the Professional Services team, including administrative staff, ensuring high-quality service delivery across the Academy. 
  • Act as the operational lead for Health & Safety, compliance, policy implementation, GDPR and risk management. 
  • Support the Principal and Senior Leadership Team on all non-education aspects of Academy operations, providing advice, oversight and practical solutions. 
  • Oversee HR administration and recruitment processes, supporting the delivery of safer recruitment practices and staff compliance requirements. 
  • Ensure statutory responsibilities, including safeguarding compliance and maintenance of the Single Central Record, are effectively managed. 
  • Drive continuous improvement, developing systems and procedures that enhance efficiency and support the Academy's strategic priorities. 
  • Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application.  

About Winterstoke Hundred Academy:       

Winterstoke Hundred Academy have students in all year groups, being oversubscribed in Years 7 to 10. Year 11 who were our first cohort of learners are a slightly smaller cohort and we have a thriving sixth form with students in Years 12 and 13. The development of the new building, which opened in 2024, saw us nearing capacity as a split-site, medium-scale 11–19 Academy. We celebrate the fact that, as a new provision, our culture, ethos and values have been ours to define from the beginning, and we are able to decide what is important to take with us into the future as we grow.   

Why work at CLF? 

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion. 

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. 

What we can offer you:  

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS).  
  • Generous annual leave.  
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities.  
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme.  
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs.  
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay.  
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more!  

Recruitment timeline:  

Closing Date: 25 November 2026 @11.59pm  

Shortlisting: 26 November 2026 

Interviews: 3 December 2026 

If you would like to discuss this opportunity prior to the closing date, please contact our recruitment team who will arrange a suitable time.  

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.  

Skilled Worker sponsorship: This role may be eligible for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship, subject to the candidate meeting the applicable Home Office eligibility and salary requirements. Full-time and 0.8 FTE positions will generally meet the required salary threshold; for other part-time working arrangements, eligibility will depend on the salary applicable to the role and the candidate's working pattern. To help us assess whether sponsorship may be available, we encourage candidates who require sponsorship to provide their current salary information when completing the application form.   

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out. 

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.
