title: Backend / Platform Developer Consultant (Temporal & Kubernetes)
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://bitovi.com

 JOIN OUR TEAM!

 Bitovi is looking for a Backend / Platform Developer Consultant to join us as we transform technology delivery. We build and operate durable, distributed systems for enterprise clients — heavy on Java Services, Temporal for workflow orchestration, Kafka for event streaming, and Kubernetes-native platform engineering on AWS to run it all reliably. If you want to build exceptional systems, take orchestration, systems engineering, and infrastructure seriously, and have ideas for making delivery more collaborative, validation-driven, and swift, we want to work with you!

 Compensation: $120,000 to $190,000 annually, depending on experience, plus annual bonus opportunity.

 PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only considering candidates located in and authorized to work in the United States.

 WHO YOU ARE

 You're experienced building and running applications at the enterprise level, and you're comfortable owning both the code and the infrastructure it runs on. You think like a systems engineer — reasoning about the whole platform, from JVM services and event streams to the clusters and cloud infrastructure underneath them. You thrive when given opportunities to deliver real-world platforms as an integral team member, including large-scale migrations, and you have the expertise to interface and communicate confidently with stakeholders.

 You'll excel in this role at Bitovi if you have:

• Strong working knowledge of Java and the JVM ecosystem (Spring Boot or similar); experience with additional backend languages (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, etc.) is a plus

• Hands-on experience with a durable execution / workflow engine — Temporal preferred (Apache Airflow, Prefect, or similar also relevant) — including modeling workflows and activities, handling retries and timeouts, and reasoning about idempotency and failure modes

• Experience designing and operating Kafka-based event streaming systems: topic and partition design, consumer groups, schema management, and reasoning about ordering, delivery guarantees, and consumer lag

• Experience designing and building GraphQL APIs — schema design, resolvers, and performance concerns (N+1, caching, pagination); federation experience a plus

• Deep, hands-on AWS experience: architecting, deploying, and operating production systems (EKS, networking, IAM, messaging, and data services)

• Solid Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and debugging production workloads

• A systems engineering mindset: understanding of complex scaling issues, concurrency, backpressure, caching strategies, and failure modes across distributed systems

• Experience planning and executing migrations — application replatforming, workflow engine migrations, data/schema migrations, or moving workloads between environments with minimal downtime

• A thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-style delivery

• Experience with observability in practice — logging, metrics, and tracing (OpenTelemetry a plus)

• Experience building modern microservice-based or serverless applications

• Database schema design and development expertise

 Other skills we value

 Temporal depth

• Running Temporal in production — self-hosted on Kubernetes and/or Temporal Cloud

• Workflow versioning and patching, safe deployments, and long-running workflow migrations

• Worker deployment and tuning (pollers, task queues, concurrency/slot configuration)

• Namespace management, mTLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE or private CA), and capacity/scaling concerns (e.g. APS/TRU on Temporal Cloud

 Kafka & event streaming depth

• Operating Kafka in production (MSK, Confluent, or self-managed on Kubernetes)

• Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, and schema registry workflows (Avro/Protobuf)

• Migrating between clusters or providers, and integrating Kafka with downstream analytical stores

• Experience with different techniques for processing large datasets, such as Lambda and Kappa architectures

 Platform / DevOps depth

• Building or operating an internal developer platform (IDP) — self-service, paved-path infrastructure for application teams

• GitOps with ArgoCD (or Flux) and a low- or zero-manual-apply delivery model

• Infrastructure as code: Terraform/OpenTofu, and provisioning AWS resources via Crossplane, ACK, or similar

• Writing Kubernetes controllers/operators (controller-runtime, kubebuilder) and working with CRDs

• Helm chart authoring and distribution (including OCI/registry-based)

• Secrets management (External Secrets Operator, etc.), autoscaling (Karpenter, KEDA), and service mesh concepts (Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE)

• EKS or comparable managed Kubernetes at scale

 General

• Interest in working across multiple backend languages

• Additional queueing and messaging technologies (AWS SQS/SNS, RabbitMQ)

• API design across paradigms (GraphQL, REST, gRPC)

• AuthN/AuthZ and related technologies (sessions, API tokens, JWTs)

• Automated testing across the stack (unit, integration, performance/benchmarking)

 WHO WE ARE

 Bitovi partners with companies to build outcome-focused apps and platforms. Our collaborative approach is driven by validation to deliver the swiftest route to the most valuable solution.

 We design and build high-profile applications and the infrastructure behind them — with tests, full docs, and a real deployment process. We run a serious Temporal practice (including large-scale migration and security work for enterprise clients) alongside deep Kubernetes, AWS, and platform engineering work. We discuss and design architectures, review code, and research new technologies. We talk to our clients, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

 We help one another freely. We keep a Slack channel called ask-help, which is constantly used. We develop new skills, build better developer tools, and work on new types of projects regularly.

 Our fully remote team comprises about 70 developers and designers. We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into professions — we want the right person, not the right collection of tech keywords.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO AT BITOVI

 Build durable systems. Design and implement Java services, Temporal workflows, and Kafka-based event pipelines, and help clients adopt durable execution and event streaming the right way — from first workflow to production scale.

 Lead modernization efforts. Plan and execute large-scale modernization efforts — moving workflows, services, and data between platforms, clusters, and clouds — with safety, observability, and minimal disruption as first-class requirements.

 Own the platform. Build and operate Kubernetes-native infrastructure and CI/CD on AWS so application teams can ship safely and quickly. Treat reliability, observability, and repeatability as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.

 Consult and manage. Consult with clients to build outcome-driven applications and platforms, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

 Travel. This is a remote, full-time position that requires the ability to travel. We travel an average of 3–5 days every quarter, and we'll always do our best to work with your schedule.

 Teach. We'll discuss opportunities for you to present at conferences, attend and give training, plan and run meetups or local groups, and create various kinds of content in your area of expertise.

 BENEFITS WE OFFER

• Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunity

• Completely remote work with flexible hours

• 401(k) matching

• 4 weeks of paid time off in addition to 8 paid holidays

• Health, dental, and vision insurance offerings

• Paid maternity and paternity leave

• STD, LTD, and Life Insurance coverage

 HOW TO APPLY

 Please share a resume or LinkedIn profile and answer the additional questions via the application link.

 OTHER

 Please note that we are not interested in working with recruiters.

 ID Verification required if invited to an interview.

 All job offers are contingent on passing a background check.

 Candidates must be located in and authorized to work in the United States; we are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitovi-backend-platform-developer-consultant-temporal-kubernetes

 About the Role

 Apollo is hiring a Business Recruiter to own full-cycle recruiting across our G&A, Sales and Marketing organizations . This is a high-ownership role on a lean, high-performing team. You will manage a portfolio of mid and senior-level requisitions, build and execute sourcing strategies, and serve as a genuine business partner to your hiring managers. This role requires someone who operates with low oversight , self-diagnoses problems before they escalate , and brings a talent advisor posture to every stakeholder conversation. The best person for this role brings their own operating system and makes the team around them sharper.

 What You Will Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for mid and senior-level roles across G&A, Sales and Marketing, with consistent delivery across multiple verticals simultaneously

• Build and execute sourcing strategies that generate qualified, diverse pipelines, and adapt those strategies based on funnel performance , not just instinct

• Conduct structured screens and interviews, design interview plans , and lead calibrated debriefs that result in clear, defensible hiring decisions

• Track funnel metrics, identify root causes of slowdowns, and bring data-informed recommendations to stakeholder conversations

• Partner with hiring managers and business leaders as a talent advisor : shape role scoping, set expectations on candidate profiles, and influence as a subject matter expert.

• Work cross-functionally with Finance, HR, and Compensation to navigate offer approvals and headcount processes with operational integrity

• Build or improve multiple workflows, processes, or tools that create efficiency beyond your own req load

 What We Are Looking For

• 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a focus on Sales, Revenue, or Marketing roles in SaaS

• Demonstrated delivery in high-growth environments where you managed complexity and ambiguity

• Comfort and credibility working with stakeholders at all levels, including the ability to challenge and influence , not just execute

• Strong data fluency : you monitor your own funnel health, diagnose issues before they surface in a check-in, and use data to drive stakeholder conversations

• Proven AI and process efficiency capability : you have built repeatable workflows or automation that measurably improved your output, and you can speak to what you built, why it works, and what changed

• Familiarity with Revenue teams, high-performing marketing orgs, and product-led growth models

• Hands-on experience with Greenhouse and Gem , with clean data hygiene as a non-negotiable operating habit

• Clear, direct communicator who can influence without authority across functions

• High agency : you identify problems, generate solutions, and drive progress without waiting for direction

title: Commercial Legal Counsel (Contractor)
description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff is looking for a Commercial Legal Counsel that will assist the in-house legal department with Insertion Orders (Agreements), third party contracts and other legal needs. This position will support the Commercial, Finance and Accounting teams, located around the world.

As a Commercial Legal Counsel at Liftoff, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of contracts that drive our business forward. You will be at the intersection of legal expertise, meticulous organization, and collaborative teamwork. Your responsibilities will encompass contract drafting, negotiation, process improvement and training. As an essential part of our team, you'll contribute to the foundation of our business relationships and help us navigate the complex world of contracts with precision and efficiency. If you're passionate about detail-oriented work, contract law, and making a meaningful impact, this role is your opportunity to shine. Join us in shaping the way we manage contracts and elevate our commitment to excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts, including vendor agreements, customer contracts, and licensing agreements, to ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including legal, sales/commercial, product, engineering, finance and accounting to understand contract terms, resolve issues, and provide guidance on contractual matters.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date contract ticketing system, respond to each contract ticket in a timely manner and track contract milestones and deadlines.
  • Assist in contract compliance, addressing any deviations or breaches.
  • Assist in the development and improvement of contract templates and standard clauses.
  • Support the contract approval process, ensuring proper authorization and documentation.
  • Provide guidance and training to employees on contract-related matters and best practices.
  • Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations impacting contract management.

Requirements:

  • 5-10 Years of experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Law, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Contracts Counsel/Legal Counsel or in a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of contract law and legal terminology.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with exceptional organizational and time management abilities.
  • Proficiency in contract management software or tools.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment globally.
  • Prior experience in ad-tech is a plus.

Location:

This position is based in London or remotely within the United Kingdom, occasionally going into the office.

This position is a contract position with the potential to become a full-time employee. The expected hours of work required for this position are 35 to 40 hours per week, with occasional early evening hours for team meetings, as the manager is located in our Redwood City office in California.

title: Analytics Lead, Full Stack
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical individual to join our Growth Analytics International team. This team plays a crucial role in conducting research, monitoring performance, and running experiments to develop exceptional products for both consumers and merchants while driving long-term growth for the business. As Affirm continues expanding into new international markets, this role will be instrumental in establishing the operational analytics framework for new launches, beginning with Australia and expanding into future international markets. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, a collaborative mindset, an eagerness to learn, and the patience to tackle complex challenges.

Our team takes an end-to-end business analytics perspective, partnering across the organization to develop recommendations and solutions that enable the business to successfully execute its growth and profitability strategies. This role requires someone who can combine analytical rigor with business acumen to influence decisions and drive measurable outcomes.

What you’ll do

  • Establish and evolve the operational analytics framework for new international markets, ensuring scalable measurement, reporting, and decision-making capabilities as we expand globally.
  • Operate with a business owner mindset by proactively identifying opportunities through analysis and product sense to enhance user experience, growth, and profitability.
  • Own business problems from end to end by translating analytical insights into recommendations and optimization strategies that support business growth, profitability, and operational excellence.
  • Take ownership of the end-to-end analytics process: define success metrics, generate insights and hypotheses, track performance, and create intuitive dashboards and reports that can be easily shared across the organization. Develop scalable analytics solutions and data models.
  • Tackle ambiguous problems by identifying the core hypotheses and designing actionable experiments to validate product-market fit and economic viability.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear and compelling narratives and business cases for leadership to inform decision-making.
  • Spearhead weekly cross-functional metric reviews, collaborating with partners to conduct deep dives into significant metric shifts and suggest actionable steps.
  • Partner effectively across Product, Risk, Finance, Commercial, and Operations to align strategies and execute against business objectives.
  • Foster strong cross-functional relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor to team members.
  • Mentor and guide junior analysts to deliver high-impact work that drives business results.

What we look for:

  • Passion to redefine the lending and financial industry for the better.
  • Strong understanding of the consumer lending and credit industry, including lending economics, portfolio performance, and credit metrics. Experience supporting international lending markets, particularly Europe and/or APAC, is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance growth objectives with profitability and develop data-driven growth strategies.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitatively rigorous subject area such as statistics, mathematics, finance, or economics.
  • 5+ years of proven success in a cross-functional analytical role.
  • Practical and theoretical knowledge of A/B testing.
  • Experience with SQL and performing statistical analysis using Python.
  • Experience simultaneously balancing multiple workstreams and prioritizing an analytics roadmap.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and a growth mindset, with hands-on experience using AI-powered tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar assistants to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, enhance problem-solving, and advocate for AI adoption across analytical workflows.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable partnering across multiple cross-functional teams, particularly Product, Risk, Commercial, Finance, and Operations.
  • Ability to think creatively and critically while thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic, and often ambiguous work environment.
  • Willingness to go out of your way to help teammates, with humility and a team-first mindset.
  • Previous experience mentoring and guiding junior analysts.

Compensation & Benefits

Equity Grade - 5

title: Principal ML Platform Engineer
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re looking for a Principal Engineer to join the ML Platform team at Synthesia.

Our team builds and operates the systems that allow researchers and product teams to train, serve, and deploy generative models reliably and efficiently. This includes research infrastructure, production serving systems, internal tooling, and the platform interfaces that connect them. A growing part of our mission is making these systems more automation-friendly and agent-oriented, so that workflows can increasingly be operated through reliable tooling rather than manual effort.

We’re looking for a strong generalist with a systems mindset:

  • someone who is comfortable working across infrastructure, backend systems, and tooling, and who has seen ML systems in practice.

  • this is not a pure ML Engineer role. We’re especially interested in people who think deeply about reliability, scalability, performance, and resource efficiency in complex production environments.

This is a hands-on IC role with significant ownership. You’ll help shape how our ML platform evolves as we scale the number of models, workloads, tools and teams relying on it.

What you’ll do

  • Design and improve the platform systems that support model training, evaluation, and production serving.

  • Build infrastructure and tooling that make ML workloads more reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient.

  • Develop internal tools and workflows that are easy to operate both by humans and by agents.

  • Work on the architecture behind how models are deployed, served, and operated across research and product environments.

  • Improve how we schedule, monitor, and debug workloads running on GPUs and cloud infrastructure.

  • Develop internal tools and abstractions and agentic systems that reduce operational overhead for researchers and engineers.

  • Drive improvements across observability, automation, reliability, and developer experience.

  • Collaborate closely with researchers and product engineers to understand pain points and turn them into robust platform capabilities.

  • Contribute to technical direction and make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs as the platform grows.

You’ll thrive in this role if you have

  • Strong experience building or operating production systems with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

  • A systems mindset: you naturally think in terms of bottlenecks, failure modes, interfaces, resource usage, and long-term operability.

  • Solid hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, Linux, and infrastructure automation.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and operating distributed workloads in production.

  • Strong coding skills, ideally in Python or similar languages used for backend systems and tooling.

  • Strong judgment around where automation adds leverage, and where human control and reliability matter most.

  • Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, or infrastructure abstractions used by other engineers.

  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments and taking ownership of open-ended technical problems.

  • A pragmatic approach: you care about solving the right problem well, not over-engineering.

Particularly relevant experience

  • Operating ML infrastructure or model serving systems in production.

  • Supporting research or data-intensive workloads.

  • Working with GPU-based systems or other performance-sensitive infrastructure.

  • Experience with observability and debugging in distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with Terraform, Datadog, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.

Bonus points for

  • Experience building agentic or LLM-powered internal tools.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal.

  • Experience working at the boundary between research and production engineering.

  • Familiarity with performance optimization, scheduling, or resource allocation problems.

  • Experience building lightweight product or developer-facing tools.

title: Group Financial Controller
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Group Financial Controller.

The ideal candidate has a deep passion for systems accounting, a track record of preparing finance functions for public markets and an innovative mindset that leverages technology and AI to build efficient and robust accounting workflows.
The Accounting team ensures the integrity of our financial information and serves as the primary stewards of the business’ financial health. They design and operate a governance framework underpinned by robust policies, controls and systems to provide oversight and challenge to the business. The team is responsible for timely and accurate reporting and exercises judgment when necessary based on a commitment to conservative and accurate reporting, a deep understanding of accounting principles and insights into our business.

We are looking for a professionally qualified accounting leader who has a deep sense of right and wrong, high integrity, and a strong sense of responsibility, understanding that the accuracy of their work is critical to the entire Company. 

You are a methodical, detail-oriented, and process-driven problem-solver who enjoys investigating discrepancies to find their root cause. You are resilient under pressure, particularly during month-end and year-end closes, and motivated by the goal of achieving a perfect, timely, and reliable result.

Perhaps unusually we prefer a leader with deep personal interest in the software and technology industry, and some data analytics, AI and ideally software engineering experience.

Location: This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. It will report to our Chief Financial Officer.

The role entails

  • Ensuring strong understanding of the risks associated with our processes and systems and leading the development and implementation of controls to mitigate those risks
  • Leading the development and identification of areas of improvement of Canonical’s policies and procedures that will enable the business to scale efficiently
  • Driving the implementation of the Canonical’s policies and procedures and the monitoring of compliance 
  • Supporting multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy
  • Managing reviews of weekly, month-end, year-end processes from balance sheet reconciliations to management accounts and statutory accounts preparation to ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial information
  • Ensuring accuracy and completeness of the recording and reporting of financial data and transactions to ensure that the Company maintains robust accounting records
  • Upholding the Company’s accounting and approval processes and controls across the organization
  • Managing external audits 
  • Developing a strong understanding of the evolving regulatory frameworks and jurisdictions in which Canonical operates and lead the assurance of Canonical’s compliance with such regulatory requirements
  • Driving projects associated with upgrading or implementing new finance systems and sensible AI adoption in the team
  • Developing professional relationships and manage communications with both internal and external stakeholders - customers, vendors, tax authorities and external advisers - including resolving questions and issues confidentially and in a timely manner
  • Managing or mentoring junior accounting staff, sharing knowledge and promoting best practices

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A strong academic background and professional qualification in Accounting or Finance (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent)
  • Extensive practical IFRS knowledge and experience
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong data analysis capabilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced setting
  • Confident communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with colleagues, management, customers, and external stakeholders
  • A proactive, analytical mindset with a genuine passion for finance and a drive for continuous improvement, process efficiency and professional development
  • Proven experience using enterprise-level accounting or ERP systems
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with NetSuite
  • Experience with Salesforce
  • Experience with a Big 4 Accounting Firm, or a Public company

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Member of Technical Staff (Robotics)
description:
We are an AI research lab building foundational intelligence for the physical world.

Our models are designed to solve complex real-world challenges, powering everything from intelligent robots to next-generation wearables and media.

We work at the intersection of world models, video generation, and robotics, building systems that represent complex environments, reason about objects and dynamics, and translate high-level AI intentions into smooth, efficient, safe, and responsive actions across a variety of robotic embodiments.

You will collaborate closely with ML researchers developing multimodal world models and generative systems, and with hardware teams and partners to ensure robotic platforms, sensing, and system dynamics behave optimally in real-world operation.

What You’ll Do

  • Build the Foundation: Collaborate with our world model team to build state-of-the-art training and simulation platform for robotics.

  • Build the "World": Develop persistent 3D/4D scene representations that maintain temporal consistency.

  • Drive Intelligence: Unlock advanced robotics planning and decision making through our in-house, cutting-edge world models.

  • Sim2Real: Ensure sensing and system dynamics perform reliably in high-stakes, real-world operations, where models think, simulate, and act.

  • Push Boundaries: Partner with top ML researchers to innovate on generative models and physical AGI.

Areas of Interest

We are particularly excited about candidates working on topics such as:

  • World models for embodied systems

  • 3D / 4D generative models

  • Robotics manipulation

  • Embodied AI

  • Multimodal AI

What We’re Looking For

  • Background in robotics, or computer vision

  • Experience with 3D perception, scene representations, or world models

  • Experience working with robotic systems, simulation, or real-world platforms

  • Strong programming skills (Python, C++, or similar)

  • Located in London or willing to relocate to London, UK

Ability to work across machine learning, perception, and robotics

Reka's Mission

Reka's mission is to build useful multimodal artificial intelligence and use it to empower organisations and businesses. We are a globally distributed foundation model startup, headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. Embracing a remote-first approach, our team brings together top talent from around the world. Our founding team, along with many of our team members, has contributed to many of the breakthroughs in AI over the past decade.


Why Reka?

  • An Elite Team: Collaborate with top-tier engineers, researchers, operators from renowned organizations like Google DeepMind and Facebook AI Research (FAIR) and successful startups, driving innovation in cutting-edge AI technology.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: Be part of a rapidly growing industry poised to transform multiple sectors globally, offering the chance to make a significant impact.

  • Mission-Driven Environment: Work alongside a collaborative, mission-focused team dedicated to advancing AI for meaningful applications.

  • Inclusive and Open Culture: Thrive in an open and inclusive work environment that values diverse perspectives and fosters creativity.

  • Generous Benefits: Enjoy 5 weeks of paid leave to recharge, comprehensive healthcare benefits including vision and dental, and additional perks that support your well-being.

  • Visa Support: We provide visa assistance for UK employees to ensure a smooth transition and support your career with us.

title: Cleaner
company: Westcliff High School for Boys Academy
description:
The Cleaner is responsible for:

Undertaking cleaning duties efficiently, safely and to the satisfaction of your line manager.

Assisting in maintaining and cleaning the School to ensure its readiness for teaching and other activities undertaken on the premises.

Working co-operatively with other team members to ensure that the School’s cleaning requirements are fulfilled.

Complying with the School’s health and safety policy and ensuring that all duties are conducted following necessary regulations, making use of appropriate protective clothing and following manual handling procedures, as required.

The Cleaner will have particular regard to the following points: S/he

shall use appropriate equipment, materials and detergents for designated areas;

shall ensure that the equipment used to undertake cleaning duties is kept in good working order and that their line manager is informed when replenishment is required and if there is a fault with equipment;

shall ensure that all cleaning equipment is cleaned before returning it to the appropriate storage area;

shall ensure adequate stocks of cleaning materials are maintained and inform their line manager when items need to be replenished using the appropriate ordering procedure;

shall report any damage or maintenance required within the School premises to their line manager;

shall ensure that windows are shut, lights turned off and doors locked before leaving the area;

shall collect up personal possessions left by teachers or students and move to lost property if appropriate; Valuables should be passed to Reception staff;

shall empty bins into appropriate refuse sacks and take waste to the appropriate disposal point;

shall deal with hazardous/infectious solutions and materials, for example, broken glass, in accordance with agreed safe working practices, removing waste to designated areas;

shall clean up body fluid and vomit as required;

shall clean toilets, sanitary areas and washrooms to the required standard;

S/he will unblock any toilet blockages found when cleaning bathrooms. If there are more serious pipework issues these should be reported to their line manager;

shall clean all surfaces, fixtures and fittings using the appropriate method;

shall clean and polish glass in doors and partitions;

shall sweep, mop, polish, buff and/or vacuum designated areas as required;

shall wash and disinfect fixtures and items as required, including drains, sinks and bins;

shall clean window ledges, cupboards tops and other like surfaces;

shall remove and replace furniture as required;

shall collect litter from around the School premises as and when required;

shall undertake seasonal duties as required, for example duties during the School holiday periods may differ at the discretion of their line manager and the Headmaster;

shall report any incidents of unacceptable behaviour or issues of concern to the appropriate member of staff;

shall undertake additional cleaning duties as required in emergencies and to cover for other cleaners in the event of staff shortage;

shall attend School events as required;

shall attend relevant meetings and training sessions;

shall follow the signing in and out procedures in place at the time of starting work and when finishing work;

shall establish and maintain good relationships with all students, parents/carers, colleagues and other professionals.

title: Senior Finance Officer
description:
Thank you for your interest in joining Anthem. We are a dynamic organisation committed to supporting thousands of children and young people to achieve great things through one of our schools.

Anthem is one of the most established school trusts in the country, serving nearly 8,000 students across primary and secondary schools in the East Midlands, London and the Thames Valley. As a multi-academy trust, Anthem is first and foremost a school improvement organisation, committed to creating ambitious and successful schools where everyone thrives, guided by our values of integrity, collaboration and excellence.

Job purpose

To support the effective financial management of Anthem through the reconciliation of key balance sheet accounts, managing credit cards, maintaining purchase and sales ledgers and providing support to Finance Administrators.

The post holder will ensure accuracy in financial records and contributes to Anthem’s overall financial integrity.

Main duties and responsibilities

Reconcile key balance sheet nominal accounts, including bank, payroll control accounts, etc, ensuring accuracy and working with schools to resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.

Manage Anthem’s credit cards including monitoring usage in line with the expenses policy, ensuring receipts are provided for all transactions and carrying out monthly reconciliations.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date purchase and sales ledgers including monthly reconciliations of these ledgers to the balance control accounts.

Ensure compliance with financial policies, procedures and internal controls.

Support Finance Administrators with complex queries and provide guidance of financial processes.

Assist with month-end and year-end procedures including journal postings and preparing lead schedules for balance control accounts.

Ensure payment lists are properly authorised and liaising with the Head of Finance, ensure there is sufficient funds in school accounts to pay suppliers and staff.

Support schools in the management of outstanding debts and that there is evidence in place to enable successful collection of debts.

Provide support to schools to ensure that invoices are uploaded to the finance systems and particularly for Direct Debit transactions.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes and systems.

Provide cover for Finance Administrators during absences.

Undertake other duties commensurate with the post as directed by the Head of Finance.

Some travel between schools and the Head Office will be required, including travel for face-to-face meetings and training.



Benefits

As part of Anthem Schools Trust, staff benefit from a supportive working environment and access to a range of employee benefits, including health and wellbeing support, professional development opportunities and financial benefits.



Safeguarding

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expect all staff, visitors and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to an Enhanced DBS check, suitable references and other essential checks. Staff involved in recruitment and selection are trained in safer recruitment, and all staff and volunteers undertake child protection training.

title: Lecturer- Inclusive Learning Performing Arts and Life Skills
description:
Join Hertford Regional College as a Lecturer in Inclusive Learning Performing Arts & Life Skills.

You will deliver high-quality, inclusive and aspirational teaching, learning and assessment across Performing Arts and Life Skills, supporting learners with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) within the Department of Inclusive Learning. The post holder will foster a safe, supportive and ambitious learning environment that places learners at the heart of everything, enabling them to develop the knowledge, skills, confidence and independence needed to thrive in adulthood. This will support learners to become active citizens, engage within their communities and progress towards further learning, supported employment or meaningful employment.

About HRC

HRC are a vibrant, dynamic further education college, recently graded a Good College by Ofsted, with students across two campuses, with ambitious growth and development targets.

HRC put people first – students, staff, the organisations that they partner with, and the local communities that they serve.

The HRC goal is to create a supportive environment for all staff in which they can develop their skills, progress their career and make a real difference in their local community. HRC ethos is evident in everything that they do and are always looking for new colleagues who share the HRC vision and values. As part of the HRC team, you will benefit from fantastic on-site facilities, exciting opportunities for career progression and relevant training opportunities to help you gain the additional skills that you need to reach your full potential.

About the Role

We are looking for an inspirational Lecturer with excellent organisational and programme management skills.

In this role, you will:

  • Act as a Personal Tutor for designated learner cohorts, providing pastoral support, monitoring attendance, behaviour, wellbeing and progress, and working collaboratively with families, support staff and external professionals to ensure learners achieve their individual outcomes and EHCP targets where applicable.
  • Be responsible for accurately recording, monitoring and evaluating learner progress, achievement and destinations through college systems, using assessment information to inform planning, provide meaningful feedback and demonstrate learner development over time.
  • The lecturer will contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by maintaining high expectations, embedding inclusive practice and adaptive teaching strategies, and ensuring that learners develop the skills, knowledge and behaviours that enable them to thrive and make sustained progress towards their individual aspirations and next steps.
  • Work collaboratively with academic teams to ensure courses run smoothly and effectively.

If you’re passionate about teaching and eager to contribute to the success of both students and educational programmes, this is the perfect opportunity to shine.

For more details, please look at the full job description.

About You

You will bring:

✔ An Initial Teacher Training qualification (PTTLS/DTLLS) or willingness to achieve

✔ Degree in Performing Arts or related subject

✔ GCSEs C or above in Maths and English (or equivalent)

✔ Proven teaching experience in subject specialism

✔Proven experience of teaching adults with Special Educational Need and/or Disabilities

✔ A real passion for creating positive learning experiences

If you love seeing students grow in confidence and ability, you’ll be right at home here.

Why Join Us?

At HRC, you’ll be part of a friendly, supportive team with access to:

- Fantastic on-site facilities

- Genuine opportunities for career progression

- Training to help you reach your full potential

- A workplace where your contribution truly matters

Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like the perfect role for you, we’d love to hear from you! Please include a supporting statement explaining how your skills and experience make you the ideal candidate.

Applications will be reviewed upon receipt, and we may close the vacancy early, so don’t delay! All positions are subject to a DBS clearance check.

That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention.  Join us to put AI to work for people.

 Job Description

 The CRM Prime AE role is a sales role built for experienced sellers who have the curiosity, confidence, and technical acumen to transform a customer’s business. People who excel at this job can lead discovery sessions, leverage value-based selling, and deliver measurable business outcomes through customer specific priorities and use cases.  Qualifications

• Experience promoting a customer success focus in a "win as a team" environment

 Additional Information

 Accommodations
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact [email protected] for assistance.
 Export Control Regulations
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | UK | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is £94,000 - £118,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Bala

You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is €85,000 - €107,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

title: Vulnerability Strategy Analyst
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£41,300-52,250 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Our VAIB team⭐

Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

As VAIB Strategy Analyst, you will play a critical role in fulfilling Monzo's mission to make money work for everyone by driving meaningful improvements for customers requiring additional support. Working collaboratively, you will leverage data, customer insights, and operational expertise to seamlessly embed vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion, and bereavement considerations into product and service design. You will take proactive ownership of complex strategic projects and use independent judgement to navigate ambiguous escalations, shape treatment strategies, and identify emerging risks. Ultimately, you will ensure that changes deliver equitable customer outcomes while maintaining strong standards of risk management, governance, and regulatory compliance.

  • Lead Strategic Delivery: Take ownership of complex VAIB workstreams, translating strategic priorities into clear delivery plans and driving improvements that balance customer needs, regulatory expectations, and operational goals.
  • Drive Data-Led Improvements: Analyze quantitative data, customer feedback, and operational insights to identify systemic barriers, proactively monitor outcomes, and develop evidence-based recommendations for strategic change.
  • Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Operations to build VAIB awareness, influence decision-making, and embed inclusive considerations into the design of customer journeys and internal processes.
  • Navigate Complex Escalations: Act as the escalation point for complex, ambiguous customer or operational issues, applying strong independent judgement to recommend proportionate solutions when clear policy guidance is unavailable.
  • Own Governance and Risk: Manage control requirements for all strategic changes, ensuring work is rigorously assessed, documented, and governed to support informed decision-making and mitigate regulatory risk.
  • Coach and Build Capability: Strengthen the wider VAIB team by proactively sharing specialist knowledge, mentoring less experienced colleagues, and elevating overall analytical and strategic ways of working.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have deep subject matter expertise in VAIB and relevant legal frameworks (e.g., Consumer Duty, Equality Act, WCAG), applying this knowledge to identify systemic barriers and proactively recommend improvements to products and customer journeys. VAIB experience is preferable but we'd also love to hear from you if you have any other regulatory background.
  • You have a proven ability to independently manage and deliver complex strategic initiatives, utilising quantitative data, customer insights, and operational feedback to investigate ambiguous challenges, resolve blockers, and implement practical solutions.
  • You have a strong grasp of risk, governance, and assurance, paired with excellent decision-making skills to confidently navigate ambiguity, appropriately mitigate risks, and ensure complex decisions are effectively balanced and documented.
  • You are highly skilled in stakeholder management and communication, with the ability to clearly convey sensitive information, constructively challenge existing approaches, and drive alignment across Operations, Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering.
  • You are committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for vulnerable customers, coupled with a dedication to sharing expertise and coaching colleagues to build the overall capability and confidence of the wider team.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £41,300-52,250 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Recruiter call (25 minutes)
  • Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)
  • Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-REMOTE #LI-CB4

Equal opportunities for everyone

title: Application Security Engineer - Agents platform
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenAgents is our platform for building and running conversational AI agents at scale. As our first Application Security Engineer embedded in the Agents team, you’ll make the secure way the easy way. You’ll build the security tooling and reusable primitives that let engineers ship securely by default.

This is a builder role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building tools and internal systems, and the rest working with engineers, staying in sync with Core Security, and doing security research. More than half of the work is greenfield and most of it starts with you, you’ll spot the problems worth solving and own each solution from idea to production.

You will:

  • Build security primitives that are easy for engineers to adopt, starting from what you find when you audit the Agents codebase

  • Review new product work for security and feed what you learn back into shared tooling

  • Lead the major security improvements to the Agents platform, working closely with Core Security

  • Make sure Agents platform uses authn and authz controls correctly and building the guardrails that keep the platform from compromising on security best practices

  • Set the security bar for the Agents platform and make meeting it the easy path for product engineers

  • Work with engineers daily to help them ship fast and safely

Requirements

  • 5+ years in application security engineering at scale, covering secure design, vulnerability management and security tooling

  • Strong software engineering skills: you have built and shipped products end to end, in production-quality code

  • Fluency in Python, our main language. Golang or another language is fine if you can pick up Python quickly

  • Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization. Experience securing cross-service communication is a bonus

  • Experience with large-scale, customer-facing backend systems and enterprise-grade security

  • Clear communication and a real enjoyment of working with developers

  • A track record of owning delivery end to end

Bonus:

  • Security for AI and LLM applications

  • Cloud-native experience (AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, IAM, networking, Linux internals)

  • Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, HIPAA)

  • Not required: Compliance certifications, incident response experience, a traditional security background, or prior domain knowledge. We care about what you have built and shipped, and open source work or conference talks are welcome evidence of that.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. However, to facilitate working with the Security Team, we prefer candidates based in GMT to GMT+3 or UK. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London or Warsaw

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
